targets.rawSql:
WITH period_range AS (
  SELECT 
    $__fromTime AS start_time,
    $__toTime AS end_time
),
recent_errors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
  ifNull(comment_normalized, '') as comment_normalized, 
  infobase_name
FROM logs.event_log
WHERE event_time <= $__toTime
  AND event_time > $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  AND level IN ('Error', 'Ошибка')
  AND (comment_normalized != '')
  AND ('$__all' IN (${infobase}) OR infobase_name IN (${infobase}))
),
historical_errors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    ifNull(comment_normalized, '') AS comment_normalized,
    infobase_name,
  FROM logs.event_log
  CROSS JOIN period_range
  WHERE period_range.start_time IS NOT NULL
    AND event_time >= period_range.start_time 
    AND event_time < period_range.end_time - INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND level IN ('Error', 'Ошибка')
    AND (comment_normalized != '' OR comment != '')
    AND ('$__all' IN (${infobase}) OR infobase_name IN (${infobase}))
)
SELECT
  r.infobase_name AS infobase,
  count(r.comment_normalized) AS new_errors_count
FROM recent_errors r
LEFT JOIN historical_errors h
  ON r.comment_normalized = h.comment_normalized
  AND r.infobase_name = h.infobase_name
WHERE h.comment_normalized = ''
GROUP BY r.infobase_name
ORDER BY r.infobase_name

WITH period_range AS (
  SELECT 
    $__fromTime AS start_time,
    $__toTime AS end_time
),
recent_errors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    ifNull(comment_normalized, '') AS comment_normalized,
    infobase_name
  FROM logs.event_log
  WHERE event_time <= $__toTime
    AND event_time > $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND level IN ('Error', 'Ошибка')
    AND comment_normalized != ''
    AND ('$__all' IN (${infobase}) OR infobase_name IN (${infobase}))
),
historical_errors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    ifNull(comment_normalized, '') AS comment_normalized,
    infobase_name
  FROM logs.event_log
  CROSS JOIN period_range
  WHERE period_range.start_time IS NOT NULL
    AND event_time >= period_range.start_time
    AND event_time < period_range.end_time - INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND level IN ('Error', 'Ошибка')
    AND (comment_normalized != '' OR comment != '')
    AND ('$__all' IN (${infobase}) OR infobase_name IN (${infobase}))
)
SELECT
  el.comment_normalized AS "Нормализованная ошибка",
  el.infobase_name AS "Информационная база",
  el.event_time AS "Время",
  el.user_name AS "Пользователь",
  el.metadata_presentation AS "Метаданные",
  el.data_presentation AS "Данные",
  el.comment AS "Комментарий"
FROM logs.event_log el
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.comment_normalized, r.infobase_name
  FROM recent_errors r
  LEFT JOIN historical_errors h
    ON r.comment_normalized = h.comment_normalized
    AND r.infobase_name = h.infobase_name
  WHERE h.comment_normalized = ''
) new_errors
  ON ifNull(el.comment_normalized, '') = new_errors.comment_normalized
  AND el.infobase_name = new_errors.infobase_name
WHERE event_time <= $__toTime
  AND event_time > $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  AND el.level IN ('Error', 'Ошибка')
  AND el.comment_normalized != ''
  AND ('$__all' IN (${infobase}) OR el.infobase_name IN (${infobase}))
  AND (empty('${comment_normalized}') OR el.comment_normalized LIKE concat('%', '${comment_normalized}', '%'))
ORDER BY el.comment_normalized, el.event_time DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  comment_normalized AS "Нормализованная ошибка",
  count() AS "Количество",
  min(event_time) AS "Первое появление",
  max(event_time) AS "Последнее появление",
  any(comment) AS "Пример комментария"
FROM logs.event_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND level IN ('Error', 'Ошибка')
  AND (comment_normalized != '' OR comment != '')
  AND ('$__all' IN (${infobase}) OR infobase_name IN (${infobase}))
GROUP BY comment_normalized
ORDER BY count() DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN metadata_presentation != '' THEN metadata_presentation
    WHEN metadata_name != '' THEN metadata_name
    ELSE '(без метаданных)'
  END AS "Метаданные",
  CASE
    WHEN comment_normalized != '' THEN comment_normalized
    ELSE '(без нормализации)'
  END AS "Нормализованная ошибка",
  count() AS "Количество"
FROM logs.event_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND level IN ('Error', 'Ошибка')
  AND (comment_normalized != '' OR comment != '')
  AND ('$__all' IN (${infobase}) OR infobase_name IN (${infobase}))
GROUP BY "Метаданные", "Нормализованная ошибка"
ORDER BY count() DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN user_name != '' THEN user_name
    ELSE '(без пользователя)'
  END AS "Пользователь",
  CASE
    WHEN comment_normalized != '' THEN comment_normalized
    ELSE '(без нормализации)'
  END AS "Нормализованная ошибка",
  count() AS "Количество"
FROM logs.event_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND level IN ('Error', 'Ошибка')
  AND (comment_normalized != '' OR comment != '')
  AND ('$__all' IN (${infobase}) OR infobase_name IN (${infobase}))
GROUP BY "Пользователь", "Нормализованная ошибка"
ORDER BY count() DESC
LIMIT 500
